question: Why is worship performed from the rising of moon and sun declared futile?
premises: Worship is considered from the rising of moon and sun.
Such worship is described as vain.
The effort results only in trouble.
inference: Worship performed from the rising of moon and sun is futile because it becomes mere trouble without result.
uncertainties: The precise temporal or ritual restriction implied by candrārkodayataḥ is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Worship performed from the rising of the moon and sun will be in vain and will be mere trouble.
